sections.heading: Parameters kya hote hain?
sections.body:
URL ke dynamic hisse ko parameter kehte hain. `/users/{id}` mein `{id}` kuch bhi ho sakta hai.

Optional parameter ke liye `?` lagao aur function mein default value do.
explain: `whereNumber('id')` – sirf digits allow karta hai, warna 404.

versionDiff.heading: Version notes
versionDiff.intro: Parameters ka behaviour teeno versions mein same hai.

debug.body: Parameters wale routes bhi `php artisan route:list` mein dikhte hain.

tasks: `/posts/{slug}` jahan slug sirf letters aur `-` ho
